options.text: Yes.

steps.player: Hey I recognise you two! You were part of the delegation to Varrock!

steps.speaker: Furia Tullus
steps.text: Indeed we were.

steps.speaker: Ennius Tullus
steps.text: More than part of. We organised the whole thing!

steps.speaker: Furia Tullus
steps.text: As was our duty.

steps.speaker: Ennius Tullus
steps.text: The Prince could have contributed.

steps.speaker: Furia Tullus
steps.text: Do not air your dirty laundry in public, brother.

steps.speaker: Ennius Tullus
steps.text: Hmph!

steps.speaker: Furia Tullus
steps.text: You. The Prince wishes to speak with you. He awaits you at the temple.

steps.player: Where do I find this temple?

steps.speaker: Furia Tullus
steps.text: On the other side of the bazaar, south of here.

steps.player: Okay. Guess I should get going then.

steps.speaker: Furia Tullus
steps.text: Indeed.

options.text: No.

steps.player: Er... I'll leave you to it.

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-eithe.player: Hey I recognise you two! You were part of the delegation to Varrock!

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-eithe.speaker: Furia Tullus
with-friends-like-these-talking-to-eithe.text: The Prince is waiting for you. You'll find him in the temple to the south, on the other side of the bazaar.

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-metzl.speaker: Metzli, Teokan of Ranul
with-friends-like-these-talking-to-metzl.text: I know your face. I have seen it a thousand times before.

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-metzl.player: Er... I think you must have me confused with someone else. We've never met.

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-metzl.speaker: Metzli, Teokan of Ranul
with-friends-like-these-talking-to-metzl.text: Yes... and no. This is our first encounter, and yet I know you better than most. You wear the face of my only true companion. You wear the face of death.

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-metzl.player: Your only companion is death? You should probably get out more.

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-metzl.speaker: Metzli, Teokan of Ranul
with-friends-like-these-talking-to-metzl.text: You jest, as your kind often do. Is that how you drown out their screams, I wonder? Is that how you hide your pain?

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-metzl.player: Well things got deep very quickly. Is this how you normally introduce yourself to someone?

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-metzl.speaker: Metzli, Teokan of Ranul
with-friends-like-these-talking-to-metzl.text: Few seek an introduction with the Sect of Ranul. They spend their days in Ralos' light. The darkness hides an inevitable truth that they prefer to shy away from.

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-metzl.player: Right... So who actually are you?

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-metzl.speaker: Metzli, Teokan of Ranul
with-friends-like-these-talking-to-metzl.text: I am Metzli, Teokan of Ranul. You I already know. You are the one that saved the life of my counterpart.

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-metzl.player: Teokan? So there are two of you?

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-metzl.speaker: Metzli, Teokan of Ranul
with-friends-like-these-talking-to-metzl.text: Yes. As Teokan of Ranul, I lead the Sect of Ranul. My counterpart, Servius, leads the Church of Ralos.

options.text: I'm meant to be meeting Prince Itzla here.

steps.player: I'm meant to be meeting Prince Itzla here.

steps.speaker: Metzli, Teokan of Ranul
steps.text: Yes you are. He is speaking with Servius, down in the crypt. Not a place you'd normally find the Teokan of Ralos, but the Prince desired the privacy only Ranul can offer.

options.text: Could you tell me more about the Church of Ralos?
Could you tell me more about the Sect of Ranul?
I'd better head down there.

steps.player: I'd better head down there.

steps.speaker: Metzli, Teokan of Ranul
steps.text: Farewell.

options.text: Could you tell me more about the Church of Ralos?

steps.player: Could you tell me more about the Church of Ralos?

steps.speaker: Metzli, Teokan of Ranul
steps.text: Those who worship the light can be found throughout these lands, and it is the Church of Ralos that leads their worship.

steps.speaker: Metzli, Teokan of Ranul
steps.text: If you wish to learn more, you should seek out Servius or one of his Teoki. They will be better placed to guide you than I, for my duty is one of darkness, not light.

options.text: Could you tell me more about the Sect of Ranul?

steps.player: Could you tell me more about the Sect of Ranul?

steps.speaker: Metzli, Teokan of Ranul
steps.text: Ralos' light can be found all across Varlamore, but when that light fades, there is only one who can guide us through the darkness.

steps.player: Ranul?

steps.speaker: Metzli, Teokan of Ranul
steps.text: Yes. You will not find many worshippers of Ranul in your travels. Indeed, many choose to hide from him their whole lives, but no matter what, we will all meet Ranul in the end.

steps.speaker: Metzli, Teokan of Ranul
steps.text: When the sun sets, it is he that will guide us. He will lead us through the Gates of Mictl to where we may finally rest. The duty of the Sect of Ranul is to ensure that all are prepared for that journey.

options.text: I'd better get going.

steps.player: I'd better get going.

steps.speaker: Metzli, Teokan of Ranul
steps.text: Farewell.

options.text: I'm meant to be meeting Prince Itzla here.
Could you tell me more about the Church of Ralos?
Could you tell me more about the Sect of Ranul?
I'd better get going.

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-metzl.speaker: Metzli, Teokan of Ranul
with-friends-like-these-talking-to-metzl.text: The Prince awaits you down in the crypt.

options.text: Could you tell me more about the Church of Ralos?
Could you tell me more about the Sect of Ranul?
I'd better head down there.

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.text: Ah, there you are. Nilsal, adventurer. I don't believe you've properly met my father. This is Servius, the Teokan of Ralos and the man whose life you saved.

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.player: Your father? I didn't realise you were related.

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.text: Yes, very fun stuff. All a bit of a convoluted mess as well! I'll be sure to tell you all about it at some point. For now though, [player name], meet Servius. Servius, meet [player name].

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.text: Nilsal, my child. It is an honour to meet you. Were it not for you, I may well already be making my journey to Mictl. On behalf of both myself and Ralos, I thank you.

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.text: Well let's not start celebrating just yet. There's a reason why we're lurking in this crypt.

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.text: Sorry about that, by the way. I'd have much rather given you a proper welcome on your arrival, but given the situation, it's probably best we take a bit more care.

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.player: It's not a problem. Although, I did have an interesting encounter on my way here.

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.text: Ah, the Tullus twins. Fascinating pair, aren't they?

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.player: Actually, I was talking about Metzli. I met her upstairs.

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.text: Oh, you met her! My deepest sympathies.

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.text: Metzli and her sect play an essential role in our lives. You should not judge her so harshly.

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.text: You're quite right, of course. But anyway, shall we get down to business?

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.text: Kuani! So we have quite the predicament on our hands. My mother isn't too happy, oddly enough, and has tasked me with sorting it all out.

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.text: Someone wants our dear Teokan dead, and we have no idea who! All we know is that they were a Varlamorian.

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.player: A Varlamorian who had access to the mainland before the treaty was signed. Surely that limits the options a fair bit?

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.text: Right you are, [player name]! In fact, it limits them to just the members of our little delegation. In other words, myself, Servius, the Tullus twins and our retinue of knights.

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.text: Now I don't think it was me... and I'm guessing you didn't try to arrange your own assassination, Servius?

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.text: I'd like to think I'd have done a better job if I had.

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.text: Too right. Very sloppy work. A top example of how not to assassinate someone. Still, probably best we track them down all the same.

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.player: So that leaves the Tullus twins and the knights.

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.text: Ennius and Furia are loyal children of Ralos. They would not wish to see my death.

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.text: Those knights should also be loyal children of Ralos, but I agree, they are far more likely candidates. Let us investigate them and see what we can find.

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.text: Servius, until we have this matter sorted, you should remain here in the capital. The palace will be the safest place.

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.text: Nonsense! I am the Teokan of Ralos and I have a duty to the people. I must return to the Teomat at once!

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.text: The Teomat does not offer the protection of the palace. You'll be an easy target there.

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.text: I am the chosen messenger of Ralos. He would not have me cower and hide. I will return to the Teomat.

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.text: Well this is a terrible idea that's definitely going to blow up in all our faces later, but it seems you have made your decision. However, I insist that you let me personally accompany you.

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.text: My child, I would be delighted to have you as a travelling companion.

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.text: [player name], since Servius here seems keen on letting this killer have another go, you'll need to investigate the knights on your own.

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.player: I'm sure I can manage that.

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.text: Kuani! Head up to the palace and find the Tullus twins. They dealt with all the fun admin work. They'll know where those knights can be found.

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.player: I'll get to it right away.

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.text: Then it sounds like we're all set. Timoiva, and may the sun light your way!

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.text: Timoiva, my child.

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.text: Ah, you're back. Shall we get down to business?

with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
with-friends-like-these-talking-to-princ.text: [player name], head to the palace and find the Tullus twins. They'll know where you can find those knights.

oh-brother-talking-to-the-tullus-twins.speaker: Ennius Tullus
oh-brother-talking-to-the-tullus-twins.text: It seems the Prince has new chores for us.

oh-brother-talking-to-the-tullus-twins.speaker: Ennius Tullus
oh-brother-talking-to-the-tullus-twins.text: Why else would he have sent the adventurer back to us?

oh-brother-talking-to-the-tullus-twins.player: You two are quite the pair, aren't you?

oh-brother-talking-to-the-tullus-twins.speaker: Furia Tullus
oh-brother-talking-to-the-tullus-twins.text: I do not believe that was a compliment, brother.

oh-brother-talking-to-the-tullus-twins.speaker: Ennius Tullus
oh-brother-talking-to-the-tullus-twins.text: Oh... Well let's get to it then. What does the Prince need now?

oh-brother-talking-to-the-tullus-twins.player: He's asked me to investigate the knights who were part of the delegation to Varrock. He suspects one of them may have been involved in the plot to kill the Teokan.

oh-brother-talking-to-the-tullus-twins.speaker: Ennius Tullus
oh-brother-talking-to-the-tullus-twins.text: Has he forgotten that he himself leads the Knights of Varlamore? Surely he'd be best placed to deal with any of their wrongdoings.

oh-brother-talking-to-the-tullus-twins.player: He's staying with Servius in case there's another attempt on his life.

oh-brother-talking-to-the-tullus-twins.speaker: Furia Tullus
oh-brother-talking-to-the-tullus-twins.text: It is wise to keep the Teokan under close protection, and we are well placed to support this investigation.

oh-brother-talking-to-the-tullus-twins.speaker: Furia Tullus
oh-brother-talking-to-the-tullus-twins.text: The delegation consisted of six knights. Given recent events, I requested they make us aware of their activities. I suggest you seek them out and ask them to return here.

oh-brother-talking-to-the-tullus-twins.speaker: Furia Tullus
oh-brother-talking-to-the-tullus-twins.text: Arrun and Claudia should be at the bazaar. Nel will be at the cothon. Velam and Azali are somewhere in Outer Fortis, likely at the pub. Mezan will be at the colosseum.

oh-brother-talking-to-the-tullus-twins.player: What if any refuse to come?

oh-brother-talking-to-the-tullus-twins.speaker: Furia Tullus
oh-brother-talking-to-the-tullus-twins.text: This crest will mark you as a representative of the Queen herself. Show it to them and they will not refuse.

oh-brother-talking-to-the-tullus-twins.speaker: Ennius Tullus
oh-brother-talking-to-the-tullus-twins.text: Not unless they fancy revealing themselves as the traitor, which doesn't seem likely.
If the player has no inventory space:

steps.text: Furia tries to give you a crest, but you don't have enough room for it.

options.text: Where can I find the bazaar?

steps.player: Where can I find the bazaar?

steps.speaker: Ennius Tullus
steps.text: Surely you passed through it on your way to the temple earlier. It's directly south of here.

options.text: Where can I find the cothon?

steps.player: Where can I find the cothon?

steps.speaker: Furia Tullus
steps.text: From here, just take the eastern path past the museum. Once you reach the water, you have found the cothon.

options.text: Where can I find Outer Fortis?

steps.player: Where can I find Outer Fortis?

steps.speaker: Furia Tullus
steps.text: It's the part of the city outside the main walls. Head south from here and you'll find it on the other side of the gates.

steps.speaker: Ennius Tullus
steps.text: Head to the pub once you get there. That's likely where Velam and Azali are.

options.text: Where can I find the colosseum?

steps.player: Where can I find the colosseum?

steps.speaker: Ennius Tullus
steps.text: On the cliffs overlooking the city, east of here. I'd be concerned if you couldn't find it. It's pretty much impossible to miss.

steps.speaker: Furia Tullus
steps.text: Mezan will likely already be inside. I'd suggest searching the training area for him.

options.text: I'd better get going.

steps.player: I'd better get going.

oh-brother-talking-to-the-tullus-twins-t.speaker: Furia Tullus
oh-brother-talking-to-the-tullus-twins-t.text: Take this crest. It will mark you as a representative of the Queen herself. Show it to the knights and ask them to return here.
If the player has no inventory space:

steps.text: Furia tries to give you a crest, but you don't have enough room for it.

oh-brother-talking-to-the-tullus-twins-t.text: If the player lost the Varlamore crest:

steps.player: I lost that crest you gave me.

steps.speaker: Ennius Tullus
steps.text: Oh good. So now there's a crest of the Queen out there somewhere that anyone could use. Why did the Prince pick this one?

steps.speaker: Furia Tullus
steps.text: We will have it dealt with. For now, take another. However, I suggest you take more care this time.
If the player has no inventory space:
Furia tries to give you a crest, but you don't have enough room for it.
Furia gives you a crest.

I'd better get going.

oh-brother-arrun-and-claudia.player: Ennius and Furia Tullus need you to return to the palace.

oh-brother-arrun-and-claudia.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
oh-brother-arrun-and-claudia.text: If that were so, you'd have proof.
If the player does not have the Varlamore crest:

steps.player: Ah, well... I... I don't.

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: Thought so. Be off with you.

oh-brother-arrun-and-claudia.text: If the player has the Varlamore crest:

steps.player: Well it just so happens I have this.

steps.text: You show the crest to the knights.

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: Hmm... Well we're not going anywhere until our work here is done. If you want us back at the palace, you'd best help.

steps.player: I can do that. What do you need?

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: A band of thieves has been active here recently, but we came up with a way to track them down. We planted a nice shiny amulet on one of the stalls. Sure enough, it was stolen soon after.

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: Find the amulet and tell us who was carrying it. We can then follow them right to the rest of their group.

steps.player: How will I find it?

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: Beat them at their own game. Go looking through a few pockets.

steps.player: Well this doesn't sound totally orthodox, but fair enough. I'll be back soon.

oh-brother-arrun-and-claudia-pickpocketi.text: You pick the man's pocket and find the stolen amulet.

oh-brother-arrun-and-claudia-talking-to-.text: If the player does not have the amulet:

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: Do you have the amulet?

steps.player: Not yet.

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: Best you get to it then.

oh-brother-arrun-and-claudia-talking-to-.text: If the player has the amulet:

oh-brother-arrun-and-claudia-talking-to-.player: I have it right here. That man in blue over there had it.

oh-brother-arrun-and-claudia-talking-to-.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
oh-brother-arrun-and-claudia-talking-to-.text: Good work. He'll lead us right to those thieves.

oh-brother-arrun-and-claudia-talking-to-.player: So you'll return to the palace now?

oh-brother-arrun-and-claudia-talking-to-.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
oh-brother-arrun-and-claudia-talking-to-.text: We'll be there once the thieves are dealt with. It won't take us long.
You give the amulet to the knights.

oh-brother-arrun-and-claudia-talking-to-.player: Hello again. Do you know how long it will be before you can return to the palace?

oh-brother-arrun-and-claudia-talking-to-.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
oh-brother-arrun-and-claudia-talking-to-.text: Not long. We'll be there as soon as the thieves are dealt with.

oh-brother-nel.player: Hello there. I'm here on behalf of Ennius and Furia Tullus. They need you to return to the palace immediately.

oh-brother-nel.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
oh-brother-nel.text: You're working for the Tullus twins? Do you have proof?
If the player does not have the Varlamore crest:

steps.player: Er... No.

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: Well rules are rules, I'm afraid. Without proof, I can't take any orders from you.

oh-brother-nel.text: If the player has the Varlamore crest:

steps.text: You show the crest to the knight.

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: Huh... Fair enough. I'm happy to return to the palace, but I can't until I've finished my work here.

steps.player: What is it you're doing? Maybe I can help get it done faster.

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: With the recent opening of the kingdom, the cothon has become much busier. Good for business of course, but not so good when it comes to smugglers.

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: We've had a tip-off that there's a ship here involved in weapons smuggling, but we don't know which one.

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: If you can find the crate of weapons and tell me what ship it's from, I'll be able to return to the palace much faster.

steps.player: Sounds easy enough.

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: You say that now, but there's no shortage of crates around here. Thankfully, the tip-off did give us some information that might help you find it.

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: The crate should be on the docks rather than on a ship. It's of a standard size and isn't part of a stack. It's directly next to two barrels of fish and opposite a bench.

steps.player: Good to know. I'll get to it and let you know what I find.

oh-brother-nel-searching-the-correct-cra.text: You search the crate, but find nothing of interest.

oh-brother-nel-searching-an-incorrect-cr.text: You search the crate, but you don't find the weapons you're looking for.

oh-brother-nel-searching-incorrect-crate.text: You search the crates, but you don't find the weapons you're looking for.

oh-brother-nel-searching-the-correct-cra.text: You search the crate and find it to be full of weapons. A label on the crate reads 'The Fortis Spark'.

oh-brother-nel-talking-to-nel-after-spea.text: If the player did not find the weapons crate:

steps.player: Not yet. Could you remind me what I'm looking for?

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: The crate should be on the docks rather than on a ship. It's of a standard size and isn't part of a stack. It's directly next to two barrels of fish and opposite a bench.

steps.player: Thanks. I'll keep looking.

oh-brother-nel-talking-to-nel-after-spea.text: If the player found the weapons crate:

steps.player: Yes, I found it. The ship it's from is called The Fortis Spark.

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: Perfect! That's my work here done then. I'll return to the palace shortly. Timoiva!

steps.player: Great!

oh-brother-nel-talking-to-her-again-afte.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
oh-brother-nel-talking-to-her-again-afte.text: Hello again. I'll be returning to the palace shortly.

oh-brother-nel-searching-any-crate-after.text: You search the crate, but find nothing of interest.

oh-brother-nel-searching-any-crates-afte.text: You search the crates, but find nothing of interest.

oh-brother-mezan.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
oh-brother-mezan.text: Sorry, but I'm waiting for someone.

oh-brother-mezan.player: Well you might need to meet with them some other time. You're needed back at the palace.

oh-brother-mezan.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
oh-brother-mezan.text: You don't work for the palace. Why would they send you?

oh-brother-mezan.player: I'm working directly for the Prince.

oh-brother-mezan.text: If the player does not have the Varlamore crest:

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: If you are, then prove it.

steps.player: Well... I can't.

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: Well then come back when you can.

oh-brother-mezan.text: If the player has the Varlamore crest:

steps.text: You show the crest to the knight.

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: Brand new here and already working for the Prince... Strange.

steps.player: Maybe, but like I say, you're needed at the palace.

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: And I'll return there... eventually. First, I'm here for some training, but it seems my training partner is a no show.

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: Hmm... You look like you know a thing or two. You can take his place.

steps.player: I can?

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: Yes! Join me in the colosseum for some training. Once we're done, I'll return to the palace.

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: Oh, and bring two attack styles in with you. I want some variety, and it will help me test my faith in Ralos.

options.text: I'm ready. Let's do this.

steps.player: I'm ready. Let's do this.

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: Kuani!

options.text: I need to go and prepare.

steps.player: I need to go and prepare.

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: I'll be here once you're ready.

oh-brother-mezan-talking-to-mezan-again.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
oh-brother-mezan-talking-to-mezan-again.text: Are you ready to train? Remember, bring two attack styles in with you. It will help me test my faith in Ralos.

options.text: I'm ready. Let's do this.
I need to go and prepare.

oh-brother-mezan-after-defeating-mezan.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
oh-brother-mezan-after-defeating-mezan.text: You fought well in there. I should train with you more often.

oh-brother-mezan-after-defeating-mezan.player: So you'll return to the palace now?

oh-brother-mezan-after-defeating-mezan.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
oh-brother-mezan-after-defeating-mezan.text: Yes, I'll head over there shortly.

oh-brother-mezan-talking-to-mezan-after-.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
oh-brother-mezan-talking-to-mezan-after-.text: Nilsal, adventurer. I'll be returning to the palace soon.

oh-brother-velam-and-azali.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
oh-brother-velam-and-azali.text: I told you not to have that last one. Look at you!

oh-brother-velam-and-azali.player: Right... The two of you have been asked to report to the palace as soon as you can.

oh-brother-velam-and-azali.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
oh-brother-velam-and-azali.text: Report? I don't think so! It's our day off!
If the player does not have the Varlamore crest:

steps.player: Okay well... Oh... I was going to show you a crest, but I seem to have lost it.

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: Okay then! Timoiva for now!

oh-brother-velam-and-azali.text: If the player has the Varlamore crest:

steps.player: Sorry, but I have this crest here that says otherwise.

steps.text: You show the crest to the knights.

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: Ah, now that's going to be a problem.

steps.player: How so?

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: Azali here can't go showing up to the palace in this state. We need to sober her up.

steps.player: Hmm... Where's the nearest fountain?

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: There's one outside the gates just to the east of here... But how does a fountain help?

steps.player: Well there's nothing like a little dunk to sober you up a bit. Azali, come with me.

steps.text: If the player already has a follower:

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: Should you not pick up your follower first?
If the player does not have a follower:

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: Ohh... We're going somewhere new? How exciting!

oh-brother-velam-and-azali-talking-to-ve.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
oh-brother-velam-and-azali-talking-to-ve.text: I thought you were going to that fountain. It's just outside the gates to the east of here.

options.text: Dialogue 1

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: Ohh, this is tiring. I think I need a quick break.

options.text: Dialogue 2

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: Can we have a break? I'm feeling a bit iffy...

options.text: Dialogue 3

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: Huh? That looks interesting...

options.text: Dialogue 4

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: Wow! What's that over there?!

oh-brother-velam-and-azali-azali-occasio.text: If the player is too fast:

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: Hey! You're going too fast!

oh-brother-velam-and-azali-talking-to-az.text: Azali starts following the player again.

oh-brother-velam-and-azali-after-leading.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
oh-brother-velam-and-azali-after-leading.text: This isn't the right way! I'm going back to the pub!
Azali dunks her head into the fountain.

oh-brother-velam-and-azali-after-leading.player: Well it will have to do. You're needed over at the palace.

oh-brother-velam-and-azali-after-leading.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
oh-brother-velam-and-azali-after-leading.text: This day is the worst. Fine, I'll head over there soon.

oh-brother-velam-and-azali-talking-to-az.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
oh-brother-velam-and-azali-talking-to-az.text: Don't worry, I'll be on my way to the palace soon.

oh-brother-velam-and-azali-talking-to-ve.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
oh-brother-velam-and-azali-talking-to-ve.text: Don't worry, I'll be on my way to the palace soon.

oh-brother-velam-and-azali-talking-to-ve.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
oh-brother-velam-and-azali-talking-to-ve.text: Nilsal. Thanks for helping out with that little issue. I'll be heading over to the palace soon.

oh-brother-judgement.speaker: Furia Tullus
oh-brother-judgement.text: Have you spoken to all the knights?

oh-brother-judgement.player: Yes. They should be here soon.

oh-brother-judgement.speaker: Ennius Tullus
oh-brother-judgement.text: Six knights, but likely only one traitor. How do you intend to work out who it is?

oh-brother-judgement.player: Well I'm going to guess asking nicely won't work.

oh-brother-judgement.speaker: Furia Tullus
oh-brother-judgement.text: After they were picked for the delegation, the knights were granted beds in the Kualti Headquarters, just west of here. I would suggest you search there for anything of note.

oh-brother-judgement.speaker: Ennius Tullus
oh-brother-judgement.text: We'll keep the knights busy until you're done.

oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-twin.speaker: Ennius Tullus
oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-twin.text: Did you find anything in the Kualti Headquarters?

oh-brother-judgement-searching-a-wrong-c.text: You search the chest, but find nothing of interest.

oh-brother-judgement-searching-the-corre.text: If the player is already holding the letter:

steps.text: You search the chest, but find nothing of interest.

oh-brother-judgement-searching-the-corre.text: If the player has no inventory space:

steps.text: You search the chest and find a letter inside, but you don't have enough room to take it.

oh-brother-judgement-searching-the-corre.text: You search the chest and find a letter inside.

oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.speaker: Ennius Tullus
oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.text: Did you find anything in the Kualti Headquarters?
If the player hasn't read the incriminating letter:

steps.player: I found a letter to one of the knights, but I haven't read it yet.

steps.speaker: Ennius Tullus
steps.text: Then you should do so and see what it says.

oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.player: I found a letter to one of the knights. It seems that Velam is our traitor.

oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.speaker: Furia Tullus
oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.text: You are sure?

oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.player: The letter directed him to arrange the death of the Teokan. It also mentioned something called Twilight's Promise and something else called the Final Dawn.

oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.speaker: Ennius Tullus
oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.text: Then it sounds like Velam has some explaining to do. This should be fun.
A cutscene begins. The summoned knights are lined up.

oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.speaker: Ennius Tullus
oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.text: Velam, step forward.
Velam steps forward.

oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.speaker: Ennius Tullus
oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.text: Velam, you have been found to be a traitor to the Kingdom of Varlamore.

oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.text: What? I don't understand!

oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.speaker: Ennius Tullus
oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.text: We know you attempted to arrange the murder of the Teokan of Ralos. Do you have anything to say about this?

oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.text: This isn't true! Someone must have set me up!

oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.speaker: Ennius Tullus
oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.text: Your lies mean nothing here. Your guilt has already been proven.

oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.text: No! This isn't right!

oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.speaker: Ennius Tullus
oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.text: For you, this is the only thing that's right.
Ennius kills Velam.

oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.speaker: Ennius Tullus
oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.text: The rest of you are dismissed.
The remaining knights leave, and the cutscene ends.

oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.speaker: Ennius Tullus
oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.text: What were you expecting? That we'd invite him to sit down for dinner and drinks? I don't know how they do things where you come from, but you're in Varlamore now. This is how we deal with traitors.

oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.player: We should have questioned him! Now we have no idea who he was working for!

oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.speaker: Ennius Tullus
oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.text: Well it's done now, so little point dwelling on it.

oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.speaker: Furia Tullus
oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.text: While my brother may have been a touch too hasty, he is right. What's done is done. You should return to the Prince and let him know.

oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.player: Itzla and Servius said they were going to something called a Teomat.

oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.speaker: Ennius Tullus
oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.text: Makes sense. The Teomat is the centre of all religion in Varlamore. The Teokan would have been eager to return to his home.

oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.speaker: Furia Tullus
oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.text: You'll find the Teomat atop Ralos' Rise, but it's quite the walk from here. You should speak to Regulus Cento outside about a faster method of travel.

oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.speaker: Ennius Tullus
oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.text: You should not waste time. The Prince will be eager to hear what you've discovered.

oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.player: Alright, I'll go and see Regulus.

oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-the-tull.text: A cutscene begins. The summoned knights are lined up.

oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-either-a.speaker: Furia Tullus
oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-either-a.text: Speak to Regulus Cento outside about a faster method of travel. You'll likely need it if you wish to travel to the Teomat.

oh-brother-judgement-talking-to-either-a.player: Alright, I'll go and see him.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-regul.speaker: Regulus Cento
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-regul.text: Nilsal, adventurer. Do you wish to return to Varrock?

options.text: Yes please.
I was told to ask you about getting to the Teomat.

steps.player: I was told to ask you about getting to the Teomat.

steps.speaker: Regulus Cento
steps.text: Ah, kuani! Well you'll be pleased to know that Prince Itzla has already granted me permission to give you your very own quetzal, free of charge!

steps.player: My own quetzal?

steps.speaker: Regulus Cento
steps.text: That's right! And I've already picked out the perfect one. This here is Renu. She finished training not too long ago and has been eagerly awaiting her first rider.
Renu perks up at the sound of her name.

steps.speaker: Regulus Cento
steps.text: Now, Renu here isn't as experienced as Primio, so don't expect her to be taking you too far. However, she's more than capable of flying anywhere in Varlamore, provided there's somewhere suitable to land.

steps.speaker: Regulus Cento
steps.text: You'll find that we already have plenty of landing sites all across the kingdom, and more are being built all the time. You could probably even build a few of your own if you wanted.

steps.speaker: Regulus Cento
steps.text: Now, why don't you two properly introduce yourselves to each other. I have the perfect thing here to help with that.
If the player has no inventory space:
Regulus tries to give you some quetzal feed, but you don't have enough room for it.
If the player has inventory space:
Regulus gives you some quetzal feed.

options.text: No thanks.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-regul.speaker: Regulus Cento
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-regul.text: Nilsal, adventurer. Do you wish to return to Varrock?

options.text: Yes please.
I was told to ask you about getting to the Teomat.

steps.player: I was told to ask you about getting to the Teomat.

steps.text: If the player does not have the Queztal feed in their invenotry:

steps.speaker: Regulus Cento
steps.text: Have you properly introduced yourself to Renu yet? She'll be able to take you right there!
If the player does not have the Queztal feed in their invenotry:

steps.speaker: Regulus Cento
steps.text: Have you properly introduced yourself to Renu yet? She'll be able to take you right there! Here, I'm sure this will help the two of you become firm iknamis.
If the player has no inventory space:
Regulus tries to give you some quetzal feed, but you don't have enough room for it.
If the player has inventory space:
Regulus gives you some quetzal feed.

options.text: No thanks.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-regul.player: Hello, Renu. I have something for you here.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-regul.text: Renu eagerly takes the feed from you.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-regul.speaker: Regulus Cento
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-regul.text: Kuani! I reckon she'll let you ride her now.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-regul.speaker: Regulus Cento
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-regul.text: Nilsal, adventurer. Do you wish to return to Varrock?

options.text: Yes please.
I was told to ask you about getting to the Teomat.

steps.player: I was told to ask you about getting to the Teomat.

steps.speaker: Regulus Cento
steps.text: You have everything you need to get there already. Renu will be able to take you!

options.text: I'd like to change Renu's appearance.
No thanks.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-metzl.speaker: Metzli, Teokan of Ranul
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-metzl.text: The Prince and my counterpart wish to speak with you. You should go to them at once.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.text: Nilsal, [player name]. How goes your investigation?

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.player: I'm still looking into those knights.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.text: Well keep at it. The Tullus twins should be able to help you where needed.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.text: Nilsal, [player name]. Welcome to the Teomat.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.text: Nilsal, my child.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.text: So, how did your investigation go?

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.player: I found a letter to one of the knights, Velam. The letter instructed him to arrange the death of Servius.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.text: Tetamo! One of my own knights! I will need to swiftly deal with this.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.player: Well there's actually no need. Ennius killed him as soon as we found out.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.text: Ah, excellent! Such should be the fate of all traitors.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.player: But Ennius killed him before we could even question him!

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.text: Hmm, that's unfortunate. It would have been good to know who he was working for. No matter though! I'm sure we'll find another way of getting to the bottom of this.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.player: Does it not bother you how quickly Ennius killed him? Is it not a bit odd?

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.text: Here in Varlamore, justice is delivered swiftly and harshly. Ennius may have taken that a bit too literally... but there's not much we can do about that now.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.player: But do you not find it suspicious? I find a letter perfectly implicating one of the knights, but he's then quickly killed before he can be questioned.
Seems like a pretty good way of covering things up, don't you think?

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.text: The Tullus family have loyally served the rulers of Varlamore since the death of Emperor Imafore. For one of them to be a traitor is unthinkable!

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.text: It's a dangerous accusation indeed. That said... the family does have a bit of a history.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.text: My family has not always ruled Varlamore. In fact, it was the Tullus family who reigned for the majority of the kingdom's history.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.text: That all ended when good old Imafore declared the kingdom to be his new empire. He celebrated by going on a nice little murder spree. One war later and dear old Imafore found himself without a head.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.text: Had that not happened, the throne would have eventually passed down to... Furia, I think... I believe she's the slightly older of the two.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.player: Right... And you don't think that might be a good reason for her and Ennius to be traitors?

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.text: Imafore's death was over a hundred years ago! His family had no love for him then, and they've loyally served the Arkans since.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.text: Yes, very true, but [player name] also has valid concerns. We need to be careful of assumptions, but it seems it would be wise for us to keep an eye on the two of them from now on.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.text: Now, [player name], did your investigation uncover anything else?

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.player: The letter I found mentioned two things: Twilight's Promise and the Final Dawn.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.text: Twilight's Promise? I've never heard of that. I wonder if it has anything to do with the Twilight Emissaries...

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.text: A nice religious cult that has an unhealthy obsession with the end of the world. They've never caused any major problems before, so we've mostly left them be.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.text: However, given this revelation, perhaps it's time to pay a little closer attention to their dealings.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.player: And the Final Dawn... What's that?

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.text: Nothing more than blasphemy! It is not something we should waste our time talking about.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.text: As you can see, the Final Dawn is a bit of a... controversial topic. It's a religious belief...

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.text: An unofficial religious belief!

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.text: It's an unofficial religious belief concerning the end of the world. Oddly enough, our friends in the Twilight Emissaries are big fans of it.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.player: Hmm... Where can I learn more about the Final Dawn?

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.text: It's not something I care to know about, but if anyone around here were to know, it would be Metzli.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.text: The Sect of Ranul are responsible for maintaining the library here. That includes dealing with any forbidden materials.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.text: Metzli returned to the Teomat shortly before we did. She'll be around here somewhere.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.player: Right, I'll go and see if she can help me.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.text: If you want to learn about the Final Dawn, Metzli would be the best person to speak to. She'll be around here somewhere.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.player: Alright, I'll see if she can help me.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-metzl.speaker: Metzli, Teokan of Ranul
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-metzl.text: We meet again. Not a chance encounter I see, for it is clear that you want something.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-metzl.player: I was hoping you could help me with some information.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-metzl.speaker: Metzli, Teokan of Ranul
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-metzl.text: Quite possibly. The Sect of Ranul know better than most that time sees the end of all things. When we are gone, what remains? Knowledge must be passed on, lest it be lost forever.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-metzl.player: Yes, what you're describing there is a book. I'm familiar with the concept.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-metzl.speaker: Metzli, Teokan of Ranul
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-metzl.text: But what is a book without the right reader? Words can be misunderstood, misconstrued. That assumes those words were even right to begin with.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-metzl.speaker: Metzli, Teokan of Ranul
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-metzl.text: Think of all that we believe to know. All those words we have read. How many were the truth, I wonder.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-metzl.player: Okay, well before we go down another rabbit hole, I'm looking for information on the Final Dawn.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-metzl.speaker: Metzli, Teokan of Ranul
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-metzl.text: The Final Dawn? This is something I can help with, but first, to understand the Final Dawn, you must understand Ximoua.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-metzl.speaker: Metzli, Teokan of Ranul
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-metzl.text: The word is a gift to us from those who walked these lands before we did. They knew the truths of this world... in a way we can only dream of.
If the player has not completed The Garden of Death:

steps.speaker: Metzli, Teokan of Ranul
steps.text: We call them the Old Ones. They understood the importance of passing on their knowledge. So much of what we know, comes from them.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-metzl.text: If the player has completed The Garden of Death:

steps.player: You speak of the Old Ones?

steps.speaker: Metzli, Teokan of Ranul
steps.text: Yes. They understood the importance of passing on their knowledge. So much of what we know, comes from them.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-metzl.speaker: Metzli, Teokan of Ranul
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-metzl.text: Our world endures in a way we cannot comprehend, but like all things, it will not do so forever. Its light will one day die, but this is not something to be feared, it is something to be embraced.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-metzl.speaker: Metzli, Teokan of Ranul
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-metzl.text: You see, we are part of a cycle. Something far larger than ourselves. When the time comes, Ralos and Ranul will come together as one, consuming these lands in holy fire, until there is nothing left but ash.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-metzl.speaker: Metzli, Teokan of Ranul
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-metzl.text: But even in ash, embers remain. From those embers, a new world will be born, and the cycle will continue once more. This is Ximoua.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-metzl.player: So you think the world will one day end? That's quite something.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-metzl.speaker: Metzli, Teokan of Ranul
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-metzl.text: Not think. Know. This knowledge is a gift. One that was passed down to us from the Old Ones.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-metzl.player: But you said it yourself: Knowledge passed down can be misconstrued. How can anyone know the truth for sure? It's not like there are any of these Old Ones around for us to ask.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-metzl.speaker: Metzli, Teokan of Ranul
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-metzl.text: Indeed, and that is why this is just one interpretation. There are those out there with another: Tsak Tauli, the Final Dawn.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-metzl.speaker: Metzli, Teokan of Ranul
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-metzl.text: They do not just believe that the world will end. They believe it is their duty to make it happen. They see it as their singular purpose, and will stop at nothing to make it so.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-metzl.player: These people... You speak of the Twilight Emissaries?

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-metzl.speaker: Metzli, Teokan of Ranul
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-metzl.text: It is said that they are amongst those with this belief.

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-metzl.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-metzl.text: [player name]! I need you outside, now! We have a little bit of an issue!

the-twilight-emissaries-after-defeating-.text: The player and Prince Itzla return to see a gravely wounded Servius.

the-twilight-emissaries-after-defeating-.speaker: Guard
the-twilight-emissaries-after-defeating-.text: I'm sorry, my Prince, but we're not sure. None of the attackers made it inside, but Metzli has disappeared.

the-twilight-emissaries-after-defeating-.speaker: Guard
the-twilight-emissaries-after-defeating-.text: Thankfully the blade missed his heart, but we should get him to the capital as soon as possible.

the-twilight-emissaries-after-defeating-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
the-twilight-emissaries-after-defeating-.text: Yes, of course. Ensure no time is wasted.

the-twilight-emissaries-after-defeating-.speaker: Guard
the-twilight-emissaries-after-defeating-.text: Of course, my Prince. We'll go at once.
The guard leaves with Servius' body.

the-twilight-emissaries-after-defeating-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
the-twilight-emissaries-after-defeating-.text: Well... this has been a bit of a mess.

the-twilight-emissaries-after-defeating-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
the-twilight-emissaries-after-defeating-.text: Word has been sent to mother about what happened here. While we wait to hear back from her, I've already been thinking about a potential plan for how we might go about dealing with our cultist problem.

the-twilight-emissaries-after-defeating-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
the-twilight-emissaries-after-defeating-.text: However, let's not worry about that just now. Instead, I wanted to thank you for all that you've done. You may be an outsider, but you've already proven yourself to be a true friend to Varlamore. Thank you, iknami.

the-twilight-emissaries-after-defeating-.player: So what's this plan you mentioned?

the-twilight-emissaries-after-defeating-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
the-twilight-emissaries-after-defeating-.text: You want to hear it already? I'd have thought you might have wanted a bit of a break from all the excitement, iknami.

the-twilight-emissaries-after-defeating-.prompt: Start The Heart of Darkness quest?

options.text: Yes.
No.

steps.player: Fair point. I'll be back once I'm ready.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: I'll be here, [player name].

the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
the-twilight-emissaries-talking-to-princ.text: Well... this has been a bit of a mess.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-prince-it.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-prince-it.text: Father should make a full recovery, though given that his would-be killers are still out there, that's not anywhere near as much comfort as it should be.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-prince-it.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-prince-it.text: I've sent word to mother about what happened here, but I've not heard back yet. Once I have, I'll start planning our next move.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-prince-it.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-prince-it.text: Don't worry, I'll be in touch soon enough. Until then, timoiva, and may the sun light your way.
